api_changes.detail: Both ids are image models. The Gemini API image generation guide's text-to-image sample uses client.interactions.create and POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions. These records are Vertex model ids, and that guide does not show a Vertex host, so this page does not show a model-id swap.

migration_checklist: Read the shutdown date for gemini-2.5-flash-image on the linked official page.
Re-check price, context, and parameters on the provider pages linked here.
Ship the change before the published shutdown date.
